sar.narrative: Customer C07297, using card C07297-K1, conducted four card-not-present transactions on November 21, 2016, with transaction IDs 3476682, 3476665, 3476633, and 3476602. All transactions occurred on a single date and were detected as part of a card-not-present new device pattern. The device associated with transaction 3476682 was flagged as new for this account, indicating a potential unauthorized device. A burst of related online transactions was detected, suggesting a coordinated activity. The fraud probability for this episode was 0.92, and evidence confirmed a card-testing sequence was detected. Customer C07297 reported that they never made the $482.12 purchase (transaction 3476682), prompting a manual review. The total exposure from these transactions was $1906.07, and the pattern matches known card-not-present fraud behavior. This activity is suspicious due to the use of a new device, the high exposure, and the customer's explicit denial of making one of the transactions.
